process_observations.observation: M2-S03 is the step that finally makes the record-type/layout build-scope cross-reference non-vacuous: before it, no layoutAssignments element existed anywhere under artefacts/, so the checker's assertion was declared but never actually exercised across three prior steps' worth of green exits. This run is the first real proof of F-01's closure.

The three profile filenames contain spaces (e.g. 'Acme Support Tier 1.profile-meta.xml') and package.xml's bare <members> entries match the filename stems exactly, character for character, so the file<->manifest derivation had no ambiguity to resolve.

None of the three profiles carries objectPermissions, fieldPermissions, userPermissions or viewAll - every object/field/tab grant genuinely lives in the M2-S02 permission sets as the step's own description claims, rather than the claim and the artefact disagreeing.

The M2-S03 acceptance test's own description text predicts the build-scope checker will print 'Scanned 14 metadata file(s)'; the live tree now has 15 and the checker printed 15. The exit code and finding count are unaffected, but the description is stale evidence for a future reader comparing predicted vs. actual output.
